connector.name: Stable Baseline
connector.registryDescription: End-to-end agent-managed company brain. Docs, diagrams, plans, Knowledge Graph. Lean & affordable.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.stablebaseline.io over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.stablebaseline, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token. Either an MCP API key with prefix 'sta_' (mint at https://app.stablebaseline.io/settings/mcp-keys) or an OAuth 2.1 access token (authorize at https://app.stablebaseline.io/oauth/authorize, token endpoint https://api.stablebaseline.io/oauth/token, dynamic client registration at https://api.stablebaseline.io/oauth/register).
